_about: The glass info cards, in order. One or more per year. Write names as [[person-id|Display name]] to make them tappable. 'in' and 'out' list who joined or left the league that season. 'quote' is an optional pull-quote. 'kind': 'beat' marks a big held moment. Levi's voice; edit freely. 'photos' is an optional list of {src, alt} (files in public/photos); they slide in from the left one after another while the card is up. 'arrive' lists people whose ribbons come in with this card even though it doesn't name them. A card with "kind": "season" (and an empty body) adds a fun fact to that year's generated champion/sacko card. "results": <year> on a story card makes it carry that season's champion/sacko lines instead of a separate card.

cards.title: Where it starts
cards.body: [[dustin-sadnick|Dustin Sadnick]] (Levi's brother) and [[doug-comes|Doug Comes]] (Tim's brother) are freshman roommates at Winona State. Years later, Dustin tells [[levi-nellen|Levi]] to look out for [[tim-comes|Tim]] on his dorm floor.

photos.alt: Dustin and Doug clowning around in a Winona State dorm hallway
Levi in 2002, headphones on in the back of a van

cards.title: The visit
cards.body: [[max-christensen|Max Christensen]] spends a high school visit weekend in Winona with his "pal" [[alex-randall|Alex Randall]].
cards.funFact: That weekend eventually brought [[tim-underhill|Tim Underhill]] (Levi's future roommate), [[alex-hoover|Alex Hoover]] and [[sam-schurman|Sam Schurman]] into our sphere.

photos.alt: Alex Randall in front of his house, the future Japs

cards.title: Freshman year
cards.body: [[levi-nellen|Levi]]'s roommate [[nate-mehlhoff|Nate Mehlhoff]] introduces him to [[max-christensen|Max]] and [[zaid-hunitie|Zaid]].

photos.alt: Levi and Nate, freshman roommates, in matching white tees and buzz cuts

cards.title: Dorm life
cards.body: Max rooms with [[jared-haldemann|Jared Haldemann]] and lives next to [[toby-bachuber|Toby Bachuber]]. Max, Zaid and Nate know [[stephen-rydberg|Stephen Rydberg]] and his little brother [[ben-rydberg|Ben]] from high school.

cards.title: On his brother's instruction
cards.body: Levi befriends [[tim-comes|Tim Comes]], whose roommate is [[luke-reinardy|Lucas Reinardy]], older brother of [[kalyn-reinardy|Kalyn]].

cards.title: Japs
cards.body: The group parties at "Japs", [[alex-randall|Alex Randall]]'s house. Alex went to high school with [[sam-schurman|Sam Schurman]].

photos.alt: The view from the roof at Japs
A night around the table at Japs

cards.funFact: A guy named Petey drank too much Jag our first weekend in college and shit himself in the bathtub here.

cards.title: Parallel Dat Park
cards.body: [[jake|Jake]] and [[alex-randall|Alex]] produced rap songs that were pretty big hits. One was called Parallel Dat Park. [[tattoo-adam|Adam Field]] got it tattooed on his body.
cards.funFact: Michelle Obama has seen this tattoo. Adam was working security detail as a Marine at Camp David when Michelle Obama walked into the gym and he was working out. He was never supposed to be seen by the First Family and she was not happy with him.

photos.alt: The tattoo: "Parallel dat Park" in blackletter

cards.title: Neighbors
cards.body: Levi, Max, Zaid, Tim and Nate befriend [[megan-hardie|Megan Hardie]], whose dorm neighbor [[kennedy-curtis|Kennedy Curtis]] is [[callan-curtis|Callan Curtis]]'s sister. Levi befriends [[dominic-morelli|Dominic Morelli]], a dorm neighbor at Prentiss-Lucas.

cards.title: English class
cards.body: Levi befriends WSU transfer [[kyle-mont-blanc|Kyle Mont Blanc]] through English courses.

cards.title: Moving in
cards.body: Levi convinces high school friend [[adam-herr|Adam Herr]] to move to Winona, in with him, Zaid, [[callan-curtis|Callan]] and [[dominic-morelli|Dominic]]. [[andy-althoff|Andy Althoff]] grew up with [[luke-reinardy|Luke Reinardy]]. When Max, Tim and Nate needed another roommate, Luke brought Andy in.

photos.alt: Levi and Adam in high school

cards.title: The league is born
cards.body: The league is named The Quest to the Bria Bowl because we are not creative and liked the show The League.
cards.funFact: Max went to a KFAN fantasy draft party, paid to go, didn't know much football, brought a binder, and threw up at the draft. Toby passed out by round 6.
[[adam-herr|Adam]] meets [[mike-whiting|Mike Whiting]] as class project partners; both love wrestling.

cards.title: First shake-up
cards.body: [[dave-skradski|Dave Skradski]], high school friend of Max, Zaid and Nate, joins WSU. [[dominic-morelli|Dom]] moves away, [[callan-curtis|Callan]] doesn't watch football, and [[jared-haldemann|Jared]] pulls off a hilarious trade on Zaid and is more or less insufferable.
cards.funFact: Nate really wanted Mike in the league.
[[tim-comes|Tim Comes]] starts a frat; [[mike-whiting|Mike]], [[jon-petters|Jon Petters]] and [[adam-herr|Adam]] join.

cards.title: Three out, three in
cards.body: [[toby-bachuber|Toby]] isn't interested, [[nate-mehlhoff|Nate]] is too busy, and [[tim-comes|Tim]] doesn't really watch football. The Rydbergs are a fairly unanimous pick, as is Petters.

cards.title: Suze and Jordan
cards.body: Many in the league have met [[josh-susee|Suze]] over the years (Levi's high school friend), so he and [[jordan-morris|Jordan]] join. Jordan's way in: [[kyle-mont-blanc|Kyle]] met him through [[fish|"Fish"]], a high school friend of Kyle's who lived in the West Campus dorms with Jordan.

quote.text: Personally, I don't want him. That's just me, everybody can have their own opinion.
quote.context: On Jordan being offered a spot

cards.title: A tumultuous season
cards.body: [[max-christensen|Max]]'s one and only year as commissioner. He fleeces [[ben-rydberg|Ben Rydberg]] in a dubious trade, pushes it through himself, and wins the title (hence the asterisk). He's voted out, and [[levi-nellen|Levi]] is reinstated.

cards.title: The current era
cards.body: [[ben-rydberg|Ben]] and [[stephen-rydberg|Stephen "Scuba" Rydberg]] exit. In: [[gabe-warneke|Gabe Warneke]] (met Zaid through a big marketing project) and [[kalyn-reinardy|Kalyn "Ging" Reinardy]] (Luke's little sister, always around the group).

cards.title: The lineup holds
cards.body: The lineup hasn't changed since. From here the story is told in champions and legacy rankings.
